title: Pickle Emoji: Copy & Paste 🫝 — the Unicode 18.0 Candidate That Took Over a Deferred Apple Core Slot
meta_description: Pickle (🫝, U+1FADD) is a draft candidate for Emoji 18.0, expected alongside Unicode 18.0 in September 2026. Its codepoint was originally reserved for Apple Core before being deferred and reassigned. Not approved yet, and no font renders it today.
hero_tagline: A whole pickle (gherkin), distinct from cucumber and eggplant — drafted for Emoji 18.0, expected alongside Unicode 18.0 in September 2026. Draft only: no font renders it yet. Click to copy the codepoint anyway.
intro: Pickle (🫝, U+1FADD) is a candidate emoji drafted for Emoji 18.0, the emoji companion to Unicode 18.0, expected to finalize in September 2026. Its codepoint has an unusual backstory: U+1FADD was originally reserved for a proposed "Apple Core" emoji in the Emoji 17.0 draft cycle; that proposal was deferred, and Unicode reassigned the freed slot to Pickle for the 18.0 cycle instead. It depicts a whole pickle (a pickled gherkin), distinct from the existing Cucumber and Eggplant emoji it's most often joked about alongside — tech-press comment sections have floated everything from "that pickle is going to break the internet" to speculation it'll "take a lot of business from" Eggplant. Because it's still a draft, no operating system, keyboard, or font currently renders it; expect a blank box or placeholder glyph until Emoji 18.0 is approved and platforms ship support.
